name: Wholly Crepe
notes: Own site (whollycrepe.wixsite.com/home) links to the restaurant's own Toast ordering page for the San Marcos location, address-matched via the Toast slug (746 S Rancho Santa Fe Rd). Read via __OO_STATE__ (parsed by balancing braces). The Toast menu object is internally named 'Wholly Crepe 3PO' - the '3PO' label (third-party-ordering) was flagged as a possible markup risk per project history, so every overlapping item was cross-checked against the restaurant's own Wix site /menu page, which is server-rendered with its own clean price data. Six spot-checked items (Kitchen Sink, The Classic, Southwest, Chicken and Pesto, Coffee, Cappuccino) matched exactly between the two sources, and no systematic markup was found - the '3PO' label appears to be an internal naming artifact rather than an inflated channel. Toast was used as the primary source because it prices each flavor/variant of the shakes, smoothies and teas individually (e.g. Chocolate Shake .50 vs Cookies N Cream .00) where the Wix site collapses several flavors under one representative price per card. All 7 sections covered: Savory Crepes, Dessert Crepes, Grilled Sandwiches, Coffee and Espresso, Shakes, Smoothies, Teas.
